name: Старые доски
style: WEATHERED PLANKS: matte faded pine buttons made from two joined horizontal boards, one subtle seam, blunt imperfect square ends, a few dark wooden pegs and restrained worn corners. Thin dark brown outline, sparse low-contrast grain, clear cream letters. Narrow rough timber panel rails, warm parchment. Primary CTA two muted rust-red stained planks with a sturdier edge. Practical expedition camp carpentry; controlled wear, no broken labels or excessive texture.
prompt: Create ONE complete fully illustrated 16:9 hub screen for intoDeDung. Use the reference for layout, fortress, labels and exactly three squad cards. Keep four top tabs, resource line, squad left, open fortress courtyard center, preparation right and main button bottom-right. Stone fortress, tents, plain red/blue flags, warm sunset; exactly three small courtyard heroes. Focus on BUTTONS AND FRAMES: every tab and action has visible MATTE WOOD as its entire face, subdued grain and diffuse shading. No lacquer, gloss, shiny metal, gold edges, glow, jewels or specular streaks. Warm cream labels on dark wood, dark ink on pale wood. Selected tab and selected hero use a quiet painted brick/ochre line plus a small marker; absolutely no bright yellow/gold card outline. Primary CTA is more prominent through silhouette and muted red-brown wood, not shine. Panel interiors calm parchment. Information rows must stay flat text, not raised buttons. Do not duplicate cards or add UI. Exact labels: 'Поход', 'Наёмники', 'Кузнец', 'Колода'; 'Отряд', 'Воин', 'Щитоносец', 'Лучница', 'Дополнительно'; 'Подготовка', '7 комнат', 'Отряд: 3', 'Колода: 10 карт', 'Готово', 'В путь'; 'Золото 100', 'Эссенция 0'. Simple readable icons. Full finished screen, no collage, no outside captions, no watermark. VARIANT: WEATHERED PLANKS: matte faded pine buttons made from two joined horizontal boards, one subtle seam, blunt imperfect square ends, a few dark wooden pegs and restrained worn corners. Thin dark brown outline, sparse low-contrast grain, clear cream letters. Narrow rough timber panel rails, warm parchment. Primary CTA two muted rust-red stained planks with a sturdier edge. Practical expedition camp carpentry; controlled wear, no broken labels or excessive texture.
